name: word-lineage
description: An Agent Skill that traces an English word's lineage phylogenetically. Invoked as /word-lineage <word or words>, it decides which layer the word came from (native Germanic, Norse, Latin, French, other) from the evidence: similarity to the source-language word, verb conjugation and morphology, the synonym set, and core versus borrowed vocabulary. It reads the word's literal meaning off the tree and places it on a bundled NEXUS network of English and its donor languages (approximate-century branch lengths, numbered merge edges for borrowing waves), with a cross-language synonym map grouped by shared root. A word-choice mode (/word-lineage meaning: <phrase>) lists candidate synonyms with their literal senses and picks the one whose literal meaning matches. One plain answer per word; corrections are folded back into the skill as dated refinements.
